catalog.name: server_status
catalog.description: Return host and Live-adapter availability without changing Live state.

catalog.name: capabilities
catalog.description: Return the negotiated read-only capability catalog.

catalog.name: plan_user_journey
catalog.description: Build a capability-aware, non-mutating plan for one of five bounded composition, sound-design, reference, recording, or performance journeys.

catalog.name: audio_analyze
catalog.description: Analyze caller-supplied normalized float32 PCM in a cancellable isolated worker; returns bounded aggregates including BS.1770-5/EBU R128 loudness and never starts playback or mutates Live.

catalog.name: audio_compare_reference
catalog.description: Compare two caller-supplied PCM sources in an isolated worker with bounded band-limited resampling, optional alignment, standards loudness level matching, and aggregate deltas; never returns raw audio.

catalog.name: audio_diagnose_live_context
catalog.description: Analyze caller-supplied PCM in isolation and link measurements to one fresh authoritative Live track snapshot without claiming that Live supplied the audio or that observed devices caused a result.

catalog.name: live_audio_capture_preview
catalog.description: Read-only preflight for one consent-bound, bounded Session-slot Resampling capture in an exact disposable Set. Requires real-Live provenance, an empty audio destination slot, and output-safety evidence.

catalog.name: live_audio_capture_apply
catalog.description: After exact confirmation, perform one bounded potentially audible Resampling capture, isolated standards analysis, evidence-linked diagnosis, and transaction-owned clip/raw-file cleanup. No raw audio or path is returned.

catalog.name: live_audio_capture_status
catalog.description: Read the authenticated mapper-owned capture lifecycle without exposing its token or raw media path.

catalog.name: live_audio_capture_emergency_stop
catalog.description: Independently stop and clean the exact observed mapper-owned capture after cancellation or host restart. Requires fresh exact capture and slot identities.

catalog.name: live_status
catalog.description: Return truthful Live-adapter status and negotiated capabilities without changing Live state.

catalog.name: live_snapshot
catalog.description: Read a bounded snapshot of the current Live Set through the configured adapter.

catalog.name: live_discover
catalog.description: Read bounded, deterministic parent-scoped Live objects without changing Live state.

catalog.name: live_session_audition_preview
catalog.description: Read-only preflight for one potentially audible Session scene launch. Requires explicit output-safety evidence.

catalog.name: live_session_audition_apply
catalog.description: Launch exactly one preflighted Session scene after exact confirmation; playback is potentially audible and is verified fresh.

catalog.name: live_session_audition_stop
catalog.description: Stop only the mapper-owned audition once and verify fresh stopped state.

confirmation.description: The exact unpredictable stopConfirmation token returned by preview/apply.

catalog.name: live_session_emergency_stop
catalog.description: Independently authorized emergency stop of exactly the Session playback targets and recording mode observed in fresh discovery. Requires no transaction and survives host restart.

expectedTargets.description: Exact active playback target keys (trackRef|clipSlotRef|sceneRef) observed in a fresh live_discover/live_snapshot read.

expectedRecording.description: Exact recording mode observed in the same fresh read.

catalog.name: live_transport_preview
catalog.description: Read-only preflight for one bounded transport change (position, loop, punch, metronome, count-in) with a playback-revision fence.

catalog.name: live_transport_apply
catalog.description: Apply an exact, unexpired transport preview with confirmation and idempotency.

catalog.name: live_clip_launch_preview
catalog.description: Read-only preflight for launching one exact clip slot, with explicit output-safety evidence and a playback-revision fence. Recording-active states refuse.

catalog.name: live_clip_launch_apply
catalog.description: Launch the exact previewed clip slot once and verify fresh fired/playing evidence.

catalog.name: live_clip_launch_stop
catalog.description: Stop only the preview-owned launched clip through its track and verify it is no longer active; other playback continues.

catalog.name: live_capture_midi_preview
catalog.description: Read-only preflight for capturing recently played MIDI, fenced to exact Session clips and scenes.

catalog.name: live_capture_midi_apply
catalog.description: Apply one exact MIDI-capture preview with idempotency, verified new clip identities, and guarded undo.

catalog.name: live_scene_capture_preview
catalog.description: Read-only preflight for capturing current Session content into one new scene, fenced to structure and playback.

catalog.name: live_scene_capture_apply
catalog.description: Apply one exact scene-capture preview with idempotency, verified scene identity, and guarded undo.

catalog.name: live_note_update_preview
catalog.description: Read-only preflight for bounded MIDI note edits by note id, including velocity, mute, probability, velocity deviation, and release velocity.

catalog.name: live_note_update_apply
catalog.description: Apply an exact, unexpired note-update preview with confirmation and idempotency.

catalog.name: live_note_delete_preview
catalog.description: Read-only preflight for deleting exact MIDI notes by id, capturing the prior notes for guarded undo.

catalog.name: live_note_delete_apply
catalog.description: Apply an exact, unexpired note-delete preview with confirmation and idempotency.

catalog.name: live_clip_duplicate_preview
catalog.description: Read-only preflight for duplicating a Session clip to another Session slot or into the Arrangement.

catalog.name: live_clip_duplicate_apply
catalog.description: Apply an exact, unexpired clip-duplicate preview with confirmation and idempotency.

catalog.name: live_arrangement_clip_preview
catalog.description: Read-only preflight for creating one Arrangement clip (MIDI, or an audio clip imported from a file path; a MIDI clip in a take lane with takeLaneRef) or, with action create-lane, a new take lane on a track (trackRef, an optional name), with exact fencing. Arbitrary deletion is unavailable; transaction-owned cleanup uses live_undo, and a take lane only Live's own undo removes.

catalog.name: live_arrangement_clip_apply
catalog.description: Apply an exact, unexpired arrangement-clip preview with confirmation and idempotency.

catalog.name: live_clip_move_preview
catalog.description: Read-only preflight for moving an Arrangement clip to a position, on its own track or another (targetTrackRef), or copying it there (keepSource: true), or moving a Session clip to another slot.

targetTrackRef.description: A Session clip's new track (with targetSceneIndex), or the track an Arrangement clip goes to (its own when left out).

keepSource.description: An Arrangement clip copied: it stays where it is.

catalog.name: live_clip_move_apply
catalog.description: Apply an exact, unexpired clip-move preview with confirmation and idempotency.

catalog.name: live_audio_clip_preview
catalog.description: Read-only preflight for bounded audio clip edits (gain, pitch, loop region, warp mode) with prior-value capture.

catalog.name: live_audio_clip_apply
catalog.description: Apply an exact, unexpired audio-clip preview with confirmation and idempotency.

catalog.name: live_mixer_preview
catalog.description: Read-only preflight for bounded mixer edits (volume, pan, mute, solo, cue, sends) with prior-value capture.

catalog.name: live_mixer_apply
catalog.description: Apply an exact, unexpired mixer preview with confirmation and idempotency.

catalog.name: live_batch_preview
catalog.description: Read-only preflight for a compound batch: an ordered, bounded list (at most 32) of composable operations (mixer.set, device.parameter.set, clip.set, track.rename, scene.rename, track.create, routing.arm) with per-operation preconditions, merged exact prior-state capture for rollback/undo, per-operation policy enforcement, and a total-change summary. One mutation per exact target per batch.

catalog.name: live_batch_apply
catalog.description: Apply an exact, unexpired batch preview with confirmation and idempotency: operations execute in order with checkpoint fencing, any clean mid-batch refusal rolls completed steps back to their exact captured prior state, and one undo record covers the whole batch.

catalog.name: live_automation_preview
catalog.description: Read-only preflight for bounded Session clip envelope edits (create/delete envelope, insert/delete points) with conflict-aware fencing. insert-step: one value held from start for length (beats), as drawing a step does; it makes the envelope when there's none, and undo takes the step (or that envelope) away.

catalog.name: live_automation_apply
catalog.description: Apply an exact, unexpired automation preview with confirmation and idempotency.

catalog.name: live_browser_search
catalog.description: Search the Live Browser catalog with ranked multi-term matching over a bounded per-root candidate cache (or exact substring fallback), returning scored results with stable identities and explicit traversal/cache provenance.

catalog.name: live_library_search
catalog.description: Opt-in read-only search over Live's own library database: owner-allowlisted Live-files-*.db (and Live-plugins-*.db for the plug-in inventory), opened read-only with fail-closed schema-version gating (files 12300, plug-ins 1, shape-probed first-hand on Live 12.4.5). Name/wildcard, tag-conjunction, kind, source, and sort filters with bounded paged results; unknown versions, missing databases, and uncheckpointed WAL state report structured unavailability. Database paths and raw filesystem paths are redacted; loadability still requires live_browser_inspect.

catalog.name: live_browser_load_preview
catalog.description: Read-only preflight for loading one exact browser item onto a target track, or into a chain of a rack on it (chainRef; the track is the chain's), with postcondition verification.

catalog.name: live_browser_load_apply
catalog.description: Apply an exact, unexpired browser-load preview with confirmation and idempotency.

catalog.name: live_device_preview
catalog.description: Read-only preflight for guarded device insert, enable, or move with exact fencing. Inserting a Simpler can load a sample in the same change (filePath with its allowedRoot, the same file authority as an audio import). Transaction-owned inserted-device cleanup uses live_undo.

catalog.name: live_device_apply
catalog.description: Apply an exact, unexpired device preview with confirmation and idempotency.

catalog.name: live_routing_preview
catalog.description: Read-only preflight for bounded routing, arm, and monitoring edits with feedback-loop guards and prior-value capture.

catalog.name: live_routing_apply
catalog.description: Apply an exact, unexpired routing preview with confirmation and idempotency.

catalog.name: live_recording_preview
catalog.description: Read-only preflight for one bounded Session or Arrangement recording start/stop with explicit intent, destination identity, and output-safety evidence.

alsoTrackRefs.description: On start: more armed tracks recorded at the same time (renders of several sources in one pass); exactly these and the destination may be armed

catalog.name: live_recording_apply
catalog.description: Apply an exact, unexpired recording preview with confirmation and idempotency.

catalog.name: live_subscribe
catalog.description: Subscribe to what changes in Live as it happens, sent as notifications/live_event (channel remote-script; each channel numbers its own events): transport (playing, recording), object (the track or scene list), selection (what's selected), name (a track, scene or clip's name or colour), mixer (a track's mute, solo, arm, volume, pan or a send), parameter (the selected device's parameters), structure (tracks, scenes, locators, a track's devices or clips), and reset (read Live again). A fader drag is one event per tick. Right-clicking something in Live and choosing Ask Kumi about this sends a pointed event (channel extension) without subscribing.

catalog.name: live_unsubscribe
catalog.description: End the active Live event subscription.

catalog.name: live_project_info
catalog.description: Read the current set's file identity, gzip/XML manifest, referenced media, and missing-media report (metadata only).

catalog.name: live_project_snapshot_export
catalog.description: Export one deterministic, bounded page of a versioned privacy-redacted semantic Set artifact. Pages contain no Live session refs or mutation authority and can be persisted for offline diffing.

catalog.name: live_project_snapshot_diff
catalog.description: Compare two complete semantic Set page bundles offline with conservative rename/reorder matching and explicit ambiguity. Observational only: no merge or Live authority is proposed.

catalog.name: als_read
catalog.description: Parse one owner-authorized .als file offline (no bridge, no running Live) into the versioned semantic Set snapshot: bounded gunzip and hardened XML reading, per-section completeness with explicitly-unavailable live-only fields, privacy profiles strict/collaboration/local, and optional canonical per-clip MIDI note extraction.

catalog.name: als_lint
catalog.description: Lint one owner-authorized .als file offline: bounded findings-only checks (clips beyond the last locator, empty tracks, missing sample references inside the allowed root, oversized clip counts, duplicate track names, unwarped long samples) with severity and object identity. Never fixes anything.

catalog.name: als_diff
catalog.description: Diff two .als files, or one .als file against one previously exported semantic page bundle, through the existing semantic diff engine. Offline provenance is labeled honestly; no merge is proposed.

catalog.name: live_project_backup_preview
catalog.description: Read-only preflight for one verified atomic backup of the current set inside its own directory.

allowedRoot.description: Explicit absolute directory allowlisting the current Set for this backup.

catalog.name: live_project_backup_apply
catalog.description: Apply an exact, unexpired project backup preview with confirmation and idempotency.

catalog.name: live_realtime_arm_preview
catalog.description: Read-only preflight for one short-lived armed realtime UDP control window scoped to exact authoritative parameter refs and explicit output-safety evidence.

catalog.name: live_realtime_arm_apply
catalog.description: Apply an exact, unexpired realtime arm preview and receive the single-use UDP control token.

catalog.name: live_realtime_disarm
catalog.description: Immediately end the active realtime control window.

catalog.name: live_realtime_stats
catalog.description: Read realtime control-plane acceptance, drop, replay, rate-limit, and sequence-gap counters.

catalog.name: live_device_parameter_preview
catalog.description: Discover an authoritative device parameter and preview a bounded numeric change without mutation. values (instead of parameterRef and value) previews many parameters of the device (up to 10000) as one change: one apply sets them all or none, and one undo restores them.

catalog.name: live_device_parameter_apply
catalog.description: Apply an exact confirmed device-parameter preview once, verify fresh authoritative state, and support guarded undo.

confirmation.description: The exact unpredictable token returned by the matching preview.

catalog.name: live_session_structure_preview
catalog.description: Preview bounded MIDI/audio track and named scene creation without mutation. Track indexes address only mutable regular tracks, never return or main tracks.

index.description: Insertion index in the regular-track collection; omitted entries default to request order.
Insertion index in the scene collection; omitted entries default to request order.

catalog.name: live_session_structure_apply
catalog.description: Apply a confirmed Session-structure preview once, verify authoritative ordering, and support guarded undo.

catalog.name: live_object_rename_preview
catalog.description: Preview a purpose-specific track, scene, clip, device, or locator rename against its exact current name.

catalog.name: live_object_rename_apply
catalog.description: Apply one exact revision-fenced rename and support guarded undo.

catalog.name: live_midi_clip_preview
catalog.description: Preview creation of a bounded MIDI clip in an empty Session slot.

catalog.name: live_midi_clip_apply
catalog.description: Apply an exact, unexpired MIDI preview with confirmation and idempotency.

catalog.name: live_arrangement_section_preview
catalog.description: Preview two named Arrangement locators for a bounded section without mutation.

catalog.name: live_arrangement_section_apply
catalog.description: Create the confirmed Arrangement section locators once and verify them authoritatively.

catalog.name: live_tempo_preview
catalog.description: Preview a reversible tempo change without mutating Live.

catalog.name: live_tempo_apply
catalog.description: Apply an unexpired tempo preview after explicit confirmation and verify the authoritative result.

catalog.name: live_device_state_save
catalog.description: Save a named parameter-state snapshot of one device or rack subtree to an owner-scoped local file: schema-versioned JSON with device class identity, parameter-layout fingerprint, content digest, and a privacy profile (parameter and device names only — no project paths, session refs, or object identities). Refuses to overwrite without overwrite=true.

catalog.name: live_device_state_recall_preview
catalog.description: Read-only preflight for recalling a saved device-state snapshot onto an exact target device (or interpolating between two states with an explicit 0..1 amount and deterministic quantization rounding). Validates the file schema/digest, fences device class identity and parameter-layout fingerprint (allowPartialLayout opts into partial recall), and lists per-parameter dispositions (applicable, skipped-read-only, skipped-missing, skipped-rebound).

catalog.name: live_device_state_recall_apply
catalog.description: Apply an exact, unexpired device-state recall or morph preview with confirmation and idempotency: parameters write through the guarded device-parameter machinery with per-step revision fencing, exact rollback on mid-recall refusal, and exact prior-state restoration through live_undo.

catalog.name: live_undo
catalog.description: Undo a verified guarded transaction only when fresh authoritative state still matches its exact postcondition.

discard.description: For a track the client made as scratch (a render it recorded): delete it though it changed since

catalog.name: live_change
catalog.description: Make one change in one call: runs the named preview tool (tool) with its arguments (args), then its apply on that preview's transaction, and answers with the apply's transaction record, so live_undo undoes it as usual; the preview's own answer is under preview. Give an idempotencyKey to retry safely: the same key with the same change reconciles it instead of making it twice. Changes the producer decides on after seeing their preview (auditions, clip launches, captures, recording, realtime arming, Live's dialogs) aren't fused: preview and apply those with their own tools.

tool.description: A *_preview tool whose family has an *_apply, e.g. live_mixer_preview.

catalog.name: live_clip_delete_preview
catalog.description: Preview deleting one existing clip, in the Session or the Arrangement (clipRef from discovery; not a take lane's clip), fenced to the clip, its track, and its slot and scene or its Arrangement neighbours. The deletion is kept: Kumi can't bring the clip back; Live's undo can. Delete only what the producer asked to remove.

catalog.name: live_clip_delete_apply
catalog.description: Apply an exact, unexpired clip-deletion preview. Refused if the clip or what surrounds it changed since the preview. live_undo can't bring the clip back; Live's undo can.

catalog.name: live_scene_delete_preview
catalog.description: Preview deleting one Session scene (sceneRef from discovery) and the clips in its slots, fenced to the scene and the Set's tracks and scenes as they are now. A Set keeps at least one scene. The deletion is kept: Kumi can't bring it back; Live's undo can.

catalog.name: live_scene_delete_apply
catalog.description: Apply an exact, unexpired scene-deletion preview. Refused if the Set's tracks or scenes changed since the preview. live_undo can't bring the scene back; Live's undo can.

catalog.name: live_track_delete_preview
catalog.description: Preview deleting one audio, MIDI or group track (trackRef from discovery) with its clips and devices; a group goes with every track inside it, nested groups' too, as Live deletes a group (alsoDeletes names them). Fenced to the track and the Set's tracks and scenes as they are now. Return tracks go with live_track_structure; Main stays. The deletion is kept: Kumi can't bring it back; Live's undo can.

catalog.name: live_track_delete_apply
catalog.description: Apply an exact, unexpired track-deletion preview. Refused if the Set's tracks or scenes changed since the preview. live_undo can't bring the track back; Live's undo can.

catalog.name: live_locator_delete_preview
catalog.description: Preview deleting one Arrangement locator (locatorRef from discovery), fenced to it and the Set's locators as they are now. The deletion is kept: Kumi can't bring it back; Live's undo can.

catalog.name: live_locator_delete_apply
catalog.description: Apply an exact, unexpired locator-deletion preview. Refused if the locators changed since the preview. live_undo can't bring the locator back; Live's undo can.

catalog.name: live_render_offline
catalog.description: Render an audio track's own clips between two beats offline, before its devices, to a file (path, format, seconds, channels, sampleRate, bitDepth, bytes): no transport, nothing audible, nothing in the Set changes. Audio tracks only; a group is refused (render its tracks). expectedName is the track's name as you read it (the bridge checks it's still that track). Needs Kumi's Live extension.

catalog.name: live_project_import
catalog.description: Copy an audio file into the Set's project folder, which Live then manages as Collect All and Save would; answers where the copy is. The file must be in allowedRoot (a folder the producer named), a real file (not a link, not on a network share) of an audio type (WAV, AIFF, FLAC, MP3, OGG...). Nothing in the Set changes. Needs Kumi's Live extension.

catalog.name: live_arrangement_midi_clip_preview
catalog.description: Preview making MIDI clips in the Arrangement with their notes: one clip (trackRef, start and length in beats, notes, name?, looping?) or several (clips: a list of those). Note starts are beats from the clip's start. A clip goes only where the track's Arrangement is empty (clear it first with live_clip_clear_range). Several clips are made in one Live undo step, their notes in a second. Undo deletes exactly the clips it made. Needs Kumi's Live extension.

catalog.name: live_arrangement_midi_clip_apply
catalog.description: Apply an exact, unexpired Arrangement MIDI clip preview, then find each clip in the Arrangement to confirm it. Refused if the tracks or their Arrangement clips changed since the preview. A retry with the same key looks for the clips before making any.

catalog.name: live_clip_clear_range_preview
catalog.description: Preview clearing an Arrangement range on one track (trackRef, fromBeat, toBeat): the clips inside go, clips crossing its edges are cut there (removes and cuts list them). The clearing is kept: Kumi can't bring the clips back; Live's undo can. Needs Kumi's Live extension.

catalog.name: live_clip_clear_range_apply
catalog.description: Apply an exact, unexpired clear-range preview. Refused if the track or its Arrangement clips changed since the preview. live_undo can't bring the clips back; Live's undo can.

catalog.name: live_device_duplicate_preview
catalog.description: Preview copying one device (deviceRef from discovery) straight after itself in its chain, with its settings. Undo deletes exactly the copy.

catalog.name: live_device_duplicate_apply
catalog.description: Apply an exact, unexpired device-copy preview. Refused if the device or its chain changed since the preview.

catalog.name: live_data_read
catalog.description: Read text saved inside the Set under a key (any key: other control surfaces' too), or with one track (trackRef). value is null when nothing is saved there.

catalog.name: live_data_preview
catalog.description: Preview saving text inside the Set (it's saved with the Set), or with one track (trackRef), under one of Kumi's own keys (they start with kumi.); null clears it. Shows what's there now; undo puts it back. With entries, more tracks' text under the same key in one apply: every place, this trackRef's included, names what was read there (expectedValue, expectedIdentity), as text of at most 256 characters; the tracks are checked to be the ones read before any is written, and each write leaves a track whose text changed since.

catalog.name: live_data_apply
catalog.description: Apply an exact, unexpired saved-text preview. Refused if the key's text changed since the preview.

catalog.name: live_automation_read
catalog.description: Read a Session clip's envelope for one parameter: whether it has one, its points and their revision. With time (a beat in the clip), also the value the envelope gives the parameter there.

catalog.name: live_device_read
catalog.description: Read what only some devices list. parameter-names: every parameter a plug-in has, configured or not (begin and end pick a range, end -1 to the last; total counts them when all were asked for). banks: a Max for Live device's parameter banks, each bank's name and its parameters' indices (-1 for an empty slot).

catalog.name: live_clip_time_convert
catalog.description: Convert a time in an audio clip's sample between beats, sample frames and seconds, as Live's warping maps them. A value is null where Live can't convert it (an unwarped clip's sample has no beat time).

catalog.name: live_message
catalog.description: Show the producer a short message in Live: in passing in its status bar, or with modal: true in a dialog they close. Nothing in the Set changes.

catalog.name: live_run_python
catalog.description: Run Python on Live's main thread. Use typed tools first, then this for APIs they don't cover; explore with dir(). mode eval returns an expression's value; exec (default) returns whatever the statements assign to result. Names: Live, song, app, obj (the optional ref's Live object), bridge. Returns JSON {ok, result, stdout, error}; error holds type, message and traceback. Live objects become {ref, type, name}, tuples and sets become lists. One step in Live's undo unless one is already open; scripts have no transaction undo. timeoutMs defaults to 5000 (1–30000); the deadline interrupts Python bytecode, and checks native calls when they return.

catalog.name: live_browser_preview
catalog.description: Play a browser item's preview (a sample, a preset) as clicking it in Live's browser does, through Live's preview output. Gives a previewId: live_browser_preview_stop with it stops that preview.

catalog.name: live_browser_preview_stop
catalog.description: Stop the browser preview live_browser_preview started, by its previewId. An earlier preview's id doesn't stop a later one.

catalog.name: live_fire_button_preview
catalog.description: Preview pressing (pressed: true) or letting go of (pressed: false) the launch button of a Session clip, a clip slot or a scene, as a player does: a press launches it, and a clip in Gate launch mode plays only while its button is held. A press is held until it's let go, Kumi disconnects, or 30 s after it. Needs output-safety evidence: it plays out loud. Nothing to undo.

catalog.name: live_fire_button_apply
catalog.description: Apply an exact, unexpired launch-button preview. Refused if the clip, slot or scene changed since the preview.

catalog.name: live_device_edit_preview
catalog.description: Preview one edit of a device that isn't a parameter. set: a setting of Roar, Shifter, Spectral Resonator, Hybrid Reverb, CC Control or Simpler by its name (setting, value; a choice is its index, and the preview lists the choices). modulate: how much a Wavetable modulation source moves a target (source, value -1 to 1, and targetIndex in its matrix or parameterRef, one of its parameters, added to the matrix if it isn't there). slice-insert, slice-move, slice-remove (time, toTime in sample frames), slice-clear, slice-reset: a Simpler's slice points. warp-as (beats), warp-double, warp-half: a Simpler's warping. resend: CC Control sends its values again. Undo puts back a setting, a modulation amount or one slice; slice-clear, slice-reset and the warps are Live's undo's to take back.

catalog.name: live_device_edit_apply
catalog.description: Apply an exact, unexpired device-edit preview. Refused if the device, or what the edit is fenced on (the setting, the matrix's targets, the slices, the sample), changed since the preview.

catalog.name: live_undo_step_begin
catalog.description: Open one step in Live's own undo history, so every change until live_undo_step_end is one Cmd-Z in Live for the producer (wrap a plan's changes in it). Kumi's own undo (live_undo) still undoes each change. The step closes itself after timeoutMs (default two minutes), when the bridge's connection goes, and when another one opens (closedPrevious says so). It groups the changes Kumi makes through the Remote Script, not those through Kumi's Live extension (offline renders, Arrangement MIDI clips, clearing a range, pad sample chains); an edit the producer makes while it's open becomes its own step and splits it.

catalog.name: live_undo_step_end
catalog.description: Close the undo step live_undo_step_begin opened; with its stepId it closes only that one (another open step is left alone, reason other-step). Nothing open answers not-open.

catalog.name: live_song_undo
catalog.description: Live's own undo, once, as Cmd-Z in Live: a last resort for when the producer asks to undo what they did in Live themselves. Never use it to undo Kumi's changes: live_undo does that exactly. It undoes whatever Live did last, closes an open undo step first, and says whether anything was undone (done) and what Live could undo and redo next. A retry with the same idempotencyKey answers again without undoing twice.

catalog.name: live_song_redo
catalog.description: Live's own redo, once, as Shift-Cmd-Z in Live: a last resort for when the producer asks to redo what they undid in Live themselves. Never use it for Kumi's changes. It says whether anything was redone (done) and what Live could undo and redo next. A retry with the same idempotencyKey answers again without redoing twice.

catalog.name: live_transaction_release
catalog.description: Give up the undo of applied transactions the client will never undo (a render's own steps, a search's settings), so they stop holding the host's transaction capacity. Nothing changes in Live.

catalog.name: live_recovery_finalize
catalog.description: Retire a protected transaction record only after authoritative manual recovery or explicit acceptance of current state. Never mutates Live or finalizes active audible work.

catalog.name: live_view_preview
catalog.description: Read-only preflight for switching Live's main view or controlling the Arrangement view (zoom, scroll, follow, track collapse).

catalog.name: live_view_apply
catalog.description: Apply an exact, unexpired view preview with confirmation and idempotency.

catalog.name: live_locator_jump_preview
catalog.description: Read-only preflight for jumping the playhead to the next/previous locator or to one exact locator.

catalog.name: live_locator_jump_apply
catalog.description: Apply an exact, unexpired locator-jump preview with confirmation and idempotency.

catalog.name: live_willington_device_preview
catalog.description: Preview exact-build Willington rack edits with complete prior-state capture: macro-name, variation-name (selected variation), macro-mapping, or selector-zone/key-zone/velocity-zone. Zone edits use ref=rack and targetRef=regular chain; capture all four integer endpoints, 0–127 (velocity 1–127). Audio racks only support selector zones. Drum/return chains are unsupported. Mapping indices are zero-based; null removes a mapping. Boolean ranges use 0–127 macro thresholds; others use parameter units. Playback must be stopped.

catalog.name: live_willington_device_apply
catalog.description: Apply an exact, unexpired Willington rack preview with confirmation, idempotency and verified readback.

catalog.name: live_follow_actions_preview
catalog.description: Preview experimental Session clip Follow Actions on an explicitly enabled Willington build. Captures all ten fields for restoration. Stopped playback required. Actions 0 none, 1 stop, 2 again, 3 previous, 4 next, 5 first, 6 last, 7 any, 8 other, 9 jump. Chances sum to 100; changing one complements the other. Time is beats; jump scenes are 1-based.

catalog.name: live_follow_actions_apply

catalog.name: live_clip_properties_apply

catalog.name: live_audio_import_apply

catalog.name: live_warp_marker_preview

catalog.name: live_scene_fire_apply

catalog.name: live_transport_action_apply

unisonMode.description: Wavetable's unison mode: 0 None, 1 Classic, 2 Shimmer, 3 Noise, 4 Phase Sync, 5 Position Spread, 6 Random Note.

voiceCount.description: Drift: how many voices, one of the counts the device row's drift.voiceCountList names (the row's voiceCount is that count's place in the list).

voiceMode.description: Drift: a place in the device row's drift.voiceModeList, 0 first.

catalog.name: live_looper_apply
catalog.description: Apply an exact, unexpired looper preview with confirmation and idempotency.

catalog.name: live_observe_subscribe

catalog.description: Poll one observer subscription for changed topics since the last poll, with deduplication, revision context, and explicit overflow.

catalog.name: live_midi_transform_preview
catalog.description: Read-only preflight for one deterministic seeded MIDI transform or generator (transpose, scale-constrain, quantize, swing, velocity-curve, humanize, legato, staccato, rotate, repeat, ratchet, chord-voicing, arpeggiate, seeded-variation, euclidean, chord-progression, drum-pattern, bassline, motif-invert, motif-retrograde, motif-augment, motif-diminish); returns the exact add/update/delete note diff, source revision, constraints, assumptions, MPE probe, and undo path.

catalog.name: live_midi_transform_apply
catalog.description: Apply an exact, unexpired MIDI transform preview with confirmation and idempotency; the deterministic diff is re-verified against a fresh fence before any note write.

catalog.name: live_browser_inspect
catalog.description: Inspect one authoritative Browser result by exact item id: stable identity, type, metadata/provenance, and explicit loadability. Browser-internal paths only; raw filesystem paths are never returned.

catalog.name: live_arrangement_automation_read
catalog.description: Read-only Arrangement automation discovery probe: one exact arrangement clip + parameter envelope with owner identity, time range, complete paged points, explicit curve unavailability, and a content revision. No arrangement automation mutation is advertised.

catalog.name: live_take_lane_read
catalog.description: Read-only bounded take-lane discovery for one exact track: ordered lane identity/name/index, per-lane clip ranges and content fingerprints, a main-lane summary, complete/unavailable flags, and a revision-bound cursor. Never starts audition, creates/deletes lanes, promotes takes, or edits the main lane.

catalog.name: live_comp_read
catalog.description: Read-only comp discovery for one exact clip: adapter-reported take-lane source segments with lane identity, paged and revision-bound; relationships the adapter cannot enumerate are reported explicitly. No comp mutation or audition.

catalog.name: live_warp_marker_read
catalog.description: Read-only warp-marker probe for one exact audio clip: the complete bounded marker set with (beatTime, sampleTime), paged without silent truncation, monotonicity checks, clip and collection revisions, explicit identity limits, and read-only mutation-feasibility evidence. Never adds, moves, or deletes a marker.

read-only.description: Local tools and read-only Live discovery; no mutation of any kind.

edit-no-audio.description: Read plus structural, MIDI, device, mixer, automation, and routing edits; no audible, audio-file, recording, realtime, capture, or filesystem-mutating tools.

performance.description: Read plus live-set control: transport, tempo, clip/scene launch, guarded audition, emergency stop, mixer, views, selection, and locator navigation. Guarded undo and recovery finalization remain available so applied transactions are never stranded; the owner-domain re-check still refuses undo for disallowed domains.

full.description: Every currently executable tool, subject to negotiated Live capabilities.
